oriel.ui.tpl.rpg.title: RPG Combat HUD
oriel.ui.tpl.rpg.desc: A Diablo-style bronze base: sloshing health and mana orbs, skill cooldowns, a boss bar, a portrait and a quest tracker.
oriel.ui.tpl.rpg.how.1: Each orb is a round container that clips its overflow; a large rounded square spins inside it, and that is the sloshing liquid
oriel.ui.tpl.rpg.how.2: A cooldown is a translucent mask with a scaleY animation, shrinking from the top down
oriel.ui.tpl.rpg.how.3: Skill icons are plain <item>s; potions with components show their colour too
oriel.ui.tpl.mcdungeons.title: Block Dungeons
oriel.ui.tpl.mcdungeons.desc: A Minecraft Dungeons-style top-down adventure: isometric tiles and lava, a rounded slate bar, health and a healing potion, artifact cooldowns on 1 2 3, souls and emeralds.
oriel.ui.tpl.mcdungeons.how.1: The floor is a checkerboard turned 45° and squashed to half height, which reads as an isometric view
oriel.ui.tpl.mcdungeons.how.2: Artifact cooldowns: a ready slot gets a gold edge; a cooling one has a mask that drains away from the top
oriel.ui.tpl.mcdungeons.how.3: Loot stands in a beam of light coloured by its rarity
oriel.ui.tpl.military.title: Modern Military
oriel.ui.tpl.military.desc: A cool-toned Battlefield-style HUD: a sliding compass strip, a sweeping radar, a crosshair that spreads when firing, hit direction and kill notices sliding in one by one.
oriel.ui.tpl.military.how.1: The radar rings are a repeating radial gradient; the sweep is a rotating conic gradient
oriel.ui.tpl.military.how.2: The compass is a long scale strip sliding inside a narrow frame, faded out at both ends with a mask
oriel.ui.tpl.military.how.3: Hit direction is a conic gradient cut into an arc by a radial mask
oriel.ui.tpl.dungeon.title: Darkest Dungeon
oriel.ui.tpl.dungeon.desc: Gothic turn-based combat: torchlight, a party of four facing skeletons, stress, a "Paranoid" break and a narrator.
oriel.ui.tpl.dungeon.how.1: Torchlight is a radial gradient brightening and dimming unevenly with a steps(1) animation
oriel.ui.tpl.dungeon.how.2: The party and the foes are real entities; -mc-yaw turns them to face each other
oriel.ui.tpl.dungeon.how.3: A red glow at the target's feet and an arrow above its head
oriel.ui.tpl.arcane.title: Arcane Enchanting
oriel.ui.tpl.arcane.desc: The enchanting table as an altar: two rune rings turning against each other, a floating spinning book, and offers that only reveal their names on hover.
oriel.ui.tpl.arcane.how.1: Each rune is rotated by its own angle and then moved out, which lines them up on the ring
oriel.ui.tpl.arcane.how.2: Each offer stacks a rune layer and a name layer; :hover swaps their opacity and offset
oriel.ui.tpl.arcane.how.3: The cost icons are the vanilla sprite sprite:minecraft:container/enchanting_table/level_1
oriel.ui.tpl.fantasy.title: Fantasy Quest
oriel.ui.tpl.fantasy.desc: A leather-bound journal: a quest giver in an arched window who turns to look at you, a quest text with a large initial, goals and rewards, a wax seal and a ribbon.
oriel.ui.tpl.fantasy.how.1: The initial is enlarged in vermilion with ::first-letter and given a gold outline
oriel.ui.tpl.fantasy.how.2: The gold lines on the cover are a few stacked box-shadows
oriel.ui.tpl.fantasy.how.3: The quest giver is an <entity follow-mouse> that turns its head after the mouse
oriel.ui.tpl.terraria.title: Terraria Style
oriel.ui.tpl.terraria.desc: Translucent blue slots, gold hotkeys, rarity names flowing with rainbow colours, hearts and stars, a minimap, and a Blood Moon slowly reddening the sky.
oriel.ui.tpl.terraria.how.1: The rarity name is a gradient clipped to the text; moving the gradient makes the colours flow through the letters
oriel.ui.tpl.terraria.how.2: The hillside is a stepped clip-path; the same shape drawn 4px lower in dirt puts grass along every step
oriel.ui.tpl.scifi.title: Future Tech
oriel.ui.tpl.scifi.desc: A sunset sinking into a neon grid: chamfered glass panels, a typing terminal, blinking alerts, a segmented energy ring and a scrolling fleet ticker.
oriel.ui.tpl.scifi.how.1: The ground is a repeating conic gradient from the vanishing point, under horizontal lines that thin out further down
oriel.ui.tpl.scifi.how.2: Glass panel = backdrop-filter blur + clip-path cutting off two corners
oriel.ui.tpl.xianxia.title: Xianxia
oriel.ui.tpl.xianxia.desc: Ink-wash mountains under a cinnabar sun: a vertical calligraphy title and seal, a taiji circled by trigrams, an unrolling scroll, talismans and a flying sword.
oriel.ui.tpl.xianxia.how.1: The title, the seal and the talismans are all writing-mode: vertical-rl, set in columns from right to left
oriel.ui.tpl.xianxia.how.2: The golden-core characters are gold text with an ink stroke; the scroll unrolls with scaleY from the top
